environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules. IAM role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/auth-service-task-role has DynamoDB PutItem/GetItem permissions. ALLOWED_REDIRECT_DOMAINS is set to 'example.com'. No WAF attached to ALB. Service is publicly accessible on port 443.
